HomeLocalIntro.label: Construction in Modena
HomeLocalIntro.title: Local contractor serving Modena and the province
HomeLocalIntro.p1: K.K Edilizia is a building contractor working in Modena and across the province: renovations and residential construction for private clients, families and small businesses.
HomeLocalIntro.p2: Full construction services — from drywall to roof replacement — with a free quote after a site survey and a single point of contact.
HomeLocalIntro.p3: Where building permits are required, the Modena municipal building code and national construction law apply: the filings (CILA, SCIA or other) are prepared by your surveyor or architect, while we carry out the work in line with the approved design and keep you and your technician updated on progress.
HomeLocalIntro.p4: Projects on flats, houses and commercial units across the Modena area — from the historic centre to districts linked to Sassuolo, Carpi and Formigine. For materials we rely on Mapei and Kerakoll systems for mortars, waterproofing and finishes; for drywall and dry lining, Knauf or equivalent certified boards, depending on acoustics, loads and wet rooms.

headings.title: What a turnkey renovation includes
headings.body: A complete project pulls several trades together: masonry, plumbing and electrics, drylining and insulation, floor and wall tiling, decorating and finishes. We work as a builder organised to manage the dependencies between stages and cut down on rework.

headings.title: Where we work: Modena and the towns around it
headings.body: We work regularly in Modena, Sassuolo, Carpi, Formigine, Castelfranco Emilia, Vignola, Spilamberto, Maranello and Rubiera, adapting protection and logistics to the old town, commercial areas and apartment blocks.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a builder and a general contractor?
faqs.a: In practice it is the coordination: a general contractor plans and integrates the stages — masonry, services, finishes — with one point of contact and operational responsibility on site.

faqs.q: Do you handle CILA/SCIA applications and building tax relief?
faqs.a: The application is prepared by the client's qualified professional. We build in line with the design and provide the paperwork needed for the filing, conformity of the services and tax relief.

faqs.q: Do you quote free of charge for turnkey renovations in Modena?
faqs.a: Yes: after a site visit we prepare a free, itemised quote with materials and estimated timings.

headings.body: A kitchen means water, gas where present, electricity and ventilation: getting the provision right cuts faults and future work. We coordinate the trades with the builder's work so every stage can be checked before the walls close.

faqs.q: Does a kitchen refit need a CILA or SCIA in Modena?
faqs.a: It depends what changes — services, walls, layout. A qualified professional assesses the filing against the rules and the RUE; we build in line with it.

faqs.q: Do you do turnkey kitchen renovations outside the city too?
faqs.a: Yes: Sassuolo, Carpi, Formigine, Castelfranco Emilia, Vignola, Spilamberto, Maranello, Rubiera and other towns in the province of Modena.

headings.title: The right sequence, so nothing leaks later
headings.body: On bathrooms and kitchens the order matters: strip-out, new waste and supply, testing, tanking, then floor and wall tiling. We sequence the stages with professional products (Kerakoll, Mapei) and check them before walls and linings are closed.

headings.title: Heating and cooling: clean provision, easier maintenance
headings.body: Well-planned provision cuts invasive work later: routes, recesses and condensate drains are thought through together with the drylining and the finishes. In homes and commercial units across Modena, Sassuolo, Carpi and Formigine, we plan logistics and timings to limit downtime.

faqs.q: Do you quote free of charge in Modena and the province?

headings.title: Thermal and acoustic insulation: comfort you can actually feel
headings.body: In many flats between the old town and Modena's residential quarters, comfort comes down to cold bridges and noise between units. We propose linings and suspended ceilings with build-ups chosen for the case, weighing space, moisture and loads, rather than one standard answer for every wall.

headings.title: Materials and systems: Knauf, Mapei, Kerakoll (or certified equivalents)
headings.body: For framing and boards we use Knauf dry systems or certified equivalents; for finishes, skims and joint treatments we often use Mapei or Kerakoll. The quote names the specification and the equivalents, so performance and traceability are kept.

faqs.q: Can plasterboard be used for acoustic insulation?
faqs.a: Yes: we choose the dry system and the build-up against the target — voices, footfall, services — and the space available.

faqs.q: Can thermal performance be improved without external insulation?
faqs.a: Often yes: insulated linings and suspended ceilings can improve comfort. Which solution fits depends on constraints, space and the design.

faqs.q: Do plasterboard and insulation need a CILA or SCIA?
faqs.a: It depends on the work and the context: a qualified professional decides against Modena's RUE and the national rules. We build what the approved design provides for.

bagno.body1: Our bathroom workflow in Modena starts with a site survey (dimensions, systems, budget and style), then a written quote with separate line items. If the job is more than cosmetic, your surveyor or architect checks whether CILA, SCIA or other filings apply under Modena municipal rules and national building codes. With a consistent title or filing, we open the site: controlled demolition, new supplies and wastes, tanking and tiling, with one K.K Edilizia lead coordinating timing, suppliers and quality.
bagno.body2: We use professional materials that signal quality construction: mortars, waterproofing, adhesives and skims from lines such as Mapei and Kerakoll (or equivalent certified systems), with technical data aligned to vapour control and UNI standards. We prepare substrates flat and true, with mesh and anti-crack treatments where needed, before large-format or traditional tiles in humid daily-use conditions.
bagno.body3: We work repeatedly along Viale Amendola, the Via Emilia corridor, between Piazza Roma and the pedestrian core, in the Quartiere Musicisti, plus Buon Pastore and Crocetta — areas where traffic, parking and condominium access shape logistics and delivery slots. We also know historic centre vs ring-road housing and province-wide jobs (Sassuolo, Carpi, Formigine, Spilamberto, Maranello, Castelfranco Emilia), adapting protection, noise and lift moves to neighbours and building rules.
bagno.body4: In condominiums we agree calendars, access and noisy windows with administrators and neighbours; we protect corridors and lifts and limit dust where possible. If partitions or risers need changes, the engineer checks structure; we supply surveys and photos for the executive design. The goal remains an efficient, hygienic bathroom compliant with regulations.
bagno.body5: Permits: we do not replace your qualified technician, but we help you understand what is typical for a Modena bathroom (municipal filings, historic constraints) and what invoices and records your accountant needs for active tax relief. We execute work matching the CILA/SCIA so inspections find no gap between filing and site.
bagno.body6: After you accept the quote, the programme covers demolition, systems, screeds, tanking and finishes — usually several weeks, depending on supplies, season and condominium coordination. You get progress updates and a documented handover. One K.K Edilizia contact from first visit to final installation.

headings.title: Why a turnkey bathroom saves time
headings.body: A bathroom refit needs masonry, plumbing and electrics, drylining where required and tiling: with a single contractor you cut the handovers between suppliers and the delays that come with them. We work in Modena's old town and across the province (Sassuolo, Carpi, Formigine, Castelfranco Emilia, Vignola, Spilamberto, Maranello, Rubiera), with logistics suited to apartment blocks and awkward access.
bullets: One site contact and a programme that holds up
Professional materials (Kerakoll, Mapei) with data sheets quoted
Coordination with your professional on CILA/SCIA and tax relief

headings.title: Compliance: CILA, SCIA, tax relief and completion paperwork
headings.body: Modena has its RUE alongside national rules: a qualified professional assesses and files the application (CILA/SCIA) and handles the design side. On site we build what was approved and hand over the paperwork that supports conformity and tax relief.

faqs.q: How long does a bathroom renovation in Modena take?
faqs.a: It depends on the services, the tile format and the building. Typically a few weeks: survey, quote, strip-out, new services, tanking and laying.

faqs.q: Do I need a CILA or SCIA to redo a bathroom?
faqs.a: Not always: a qualified professional decides, based on the work (services, internal changes, constraints) and Modena's RUE. We build in line with whatever is filed.

faqs.q: Do you quote free of charge?
faqs.a: Yes: after a visit in Modena or the province we prepare a detailed quote with line items, materials and timings for a turnkey job.

ImpresaEdileModenaPage.title: Building work in Modena: how we work, where, and how long it takes
ImpresaEdileModenaPage.intro: If you’re looking for a building contractor or construction services in Modena and the province, this page explains what we do (turnkey renovations and targeted trades), where we work, and how to get a free detailed quote after a site survey.
ImpresaEdileModenaPage.p1: K.K Edilizia works in Modena and across the province (including Sassuolo, Carpi, Formigine, Spilamberto, Maranello and Vignola). We provide full construction services: turnkey renovations, targeted work (bathroom, kitchen, drywall, floors, roof and façades) and coordinated MEP with one site contact.
ImpresaEdileModenaPage.p2: We work in line with the approved design and permits where required (CILA, SCIA or other, as prepared by your surveyor or architect). The detailed quote follows a site survey: it’s free and non-binding until a written agreement is signed.
ImpresaEdileModenaPage.p3: For materials we favour brands common on Italian sites (e.g. Mapei, Kerakoll, Knauf or certified equivalents), with clear line items in the quote and technical alternatives where it makes sense.
ImpresaEdileModenaPage.p4: For projects similar to yours, start from the portfolio: each entry lists type and location. For a first budget check you can also use the cost estimate tool, if enabled on the site.
ImpresaEdileModenaPage.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about building work in Modena and its province
ImpresaEdileModenaPage.q1: How much does a renovation cost in Modena?
ImpresaEdileModenaPage.a1: It depends on size, condition, finishes and systems. After a survey we provide a quote with line items and timing; any online estimate is indicative only.
ImpresaEdileModenaPage.q2: Do you work only in Modena city or in the province too?
ImpresaEdileModenaPage.a2: We work in Modena and the main municipalities in the province; the list aligns with the footer and structured data on this site.
ImpresaEdileModenaPage.a3: Coordination of phases (demolition, systems, finishes) with one contact, instead of juggling several trades without a single site lead.
ImpresaEdileModenaPage.a4: Yes: the detailed quote after survey is free and without obligation until a contract is signed.
ImpresaEdileModenaPage.a5: Use the contact form, request a quote or book a site visit—we’ll get back to you with next steps.

AboutPage.title: About us
AboutPage.intro: {brand} brings together skilled tradespeople and project management: a single point of contact to plan the site, coordinate suppliers, and meet the timelines we promise our clients.
AboutPage.craftTitle: One site, one point of contact
AboutPage.craftP1: The person who comes out to survey the job is the same person who runs the site through to handover. One voice for decisions, for surprises, and for dates — not a switchboard passing you to another department.
AboutPage.craftP2: Around that contact work specialist tradespeople and firms — masonry, systems, drylining, finishes — chosen for the job at hand and coordinated by us. You speak to one person; the coordination is our problem, not yours.
AboutPage.craftP3: It is a way of working sized for human-scale jobs: flats, houses, offices and small commercial spaces. We would rather turn down work we could not run properly than run it badly.
AboutPage.quote: A quote is a promise in writing. That is why we itemise it line by line, with timings, before the site opens.
AboutPage.pillarsTitle: Four things we do not compromise on
AboutPage.p1d: Masonry, systems, finishes: in-house roles and certified partners for every phase.
AboutPage.p2d: Proper documentation, PPE on site, and coordination aligned with current regulations.
AboutPage.p3d: Selected materials and on-site checks for a result that lasts.
AboutPage.p4d: Professional indemnity cover, site documentation and PPE for the crew. The full wording is further down the page, without convenient acronyms.
AboutPage.territoryP1: We work where we live: the city of Modena and its province, with neighbouring municipalities assessed case by case. Sassuolo, Carpi, Formigine and the surrounding villages are within the radius where we can be on site the day after a call.
AboutPage.territoryP2: Knowing the area means knowing what is built on it: 1960s apartment blocks, courtyard houses, flats in the historic centre where every job goes through the municipal building regulations. Your surveyor or architect files the paperwork; we build to the approved design and keep both of you up to date.
AboutPage.galleryIntro: Every job goes through the same phases, in the same order: open the site, make it safe, do the work, hand it over clean. The scale and the timings change; the sequence does not.
AboutPage.g1: Opening the site: protection, setting out, and services marked before a wall is touched.
AboutPage.g2: Masonry: partitions, repairs and new openings, with line and level on every course.
AboutPage.g3: Scaffolding and safety measures when the job touches the outside of the building.
AboutPage.g4: Facades and roofs: repair work on existing buildings, often in historic settings.
AboutPage.g5: Lofts and reclaimed spaces: insulation, drylining and chased-in services.
AboutPage.g6: Handover: floors laid, decoration finished, the site cleared.
